description: Today's assigned EDGE basket as execution-ready Hyperliquid orders: symbol, entry reference, stop, exit time and max size in USD for your wallet. 8 calls on normal days, 4 on defensive days. Pass your wallet: if it has approved EDGE's builder fee, no signature is needed; otherwise sign the access message (first day free). Without either it returns the free preview.

message.description: Optional if the wallet has approved EDGE's builder fee. The exact message returned by get_access_message.

risk_pct.description: Risk per trade in percent. Default 0.375, max 0.5.

signature.description: Optional if the wallet has approved EDGE's builder fee. personal_sign signature of message by wallet.
